svg.desc: Editable wedding RSVP invitation vector design. All UI elements are SVG shapes and text for Figma import.
svg.text: With immense joy and filled with love,
have the honor of inviting you to celebrate the most beautiful day of their lives.
Having united their hearts with the promise of a sincere and eternal love,
they would be very happy to have you among their loved ones
to share this unique moment of happiness and emotion.
Civil marriage at the Bumbu town hall,
Dance party at the Christelle Love Hall,
